title: Chief Executive Order 30 Conduct of General Elections Sixth Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 30 Conduct of General Elections Sixth Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
(SIXTH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 30 OF 2002
An order further
to amend the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, dated 17-10-2002]
F. No.2(4)/2002-Pub. dated
17-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Conduct of General
Elections (Sixth Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 9th October,
2002.

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 30 Conduct of General Elections Sixth Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Article 5, Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
(SIXTH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 30 OF 2002
An order further
to amend the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, dated 17-10-2002]
F. No.2(4)/2002-Pub. dated
17-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of Article 5,
Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002.---In the Conduct of General Elections
Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002), hereinafter referred to as
the said Order, in Article 5, in clause (4),---
(i) in
sub-clause (e), for the semi-colon at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:-
"Provided that for the
purpose of this sub-clause, the total number of general seats won by a
political party shall include the independent returned candidate or candidates
who may duly join such political party within three days of the publication in
the official Gazette of the names of the returned candidates;"
(ii) in
sub-clause (f), for the semi-colon and word "and" a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:-
"Provided that for the
purpose of this sub-clause, the total number of general seats won by a
political party shall include the independent returned candidate or candidates
who may duly join such political party within three days of the publication in
the official Gazette of the names of the returned candidates;" and
(iii) sub-clause (g) shall be
omitted.
